author: fishbell
title: Windows CC build fails with linker out-of-memory errors under high parallelism
signature: Windows Release build runs out of memory - compiler fatal error C1060 (out of heap space) and linker fatal error LNK1102 (out of memory) under high parallelism|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: Build_And_Run_Collect_Mode
failed_jobs.symptom: ninja build stopped: multiple link.exe invocations failed with LNK1102 'out of memory' while linking throughput_benchmark.exe, classification_sample_async.exe and ov_transformations_tests.exe

root_cause: The Windows CC (conditional-compilation collect-mode) build runs ninja with CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL=31 on a shared Windows runner. Several final link steps (throughput_benchmark.exe, classification_sample_async.exe, ov_transformations_tests.exe) ran concurrently near the end of the build, and MSVC link.exe exhausted available memory under that parallelism, failing with LNK1102. This is not caused by the merged PR's code change; it is the fourth recorded occurrence of this exact signature on this job, indicating the runner's memory/parallelism budget for this job is consistently insufficient under current build size and concurrency.
reproduction_steps: Not reliably reproducible outside CI since it depends on runner memory pressure and link-step concurrency. Locally, building the full OpenVINO Windows Release CC configuration with 'ninja -j 31' (or similarly high -j) on a machine with limited RAM while all sample/test executables are linked concurrently can reproduce LNK1102.
recommended_actions: Reduce CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL for the Windows CC job (currently 31) or cap link-step parallelism specifically (e.g., via a Ninja pool limiting concurrent link jobs) to avoid memory exhaustion during the final link phase.
Consider splitting/serializing the linking of large executables (ov_transformations_tests.exe, samples) from the rest of the parallel build graph.
Evaluate increasing the Windows runner's available memory/swap for this job, or move to a larger runner SKU if cost allows.
Re-run the failed job once infra-level mitigation is applied; no code change is required.
prevention_strategies: Track recurrence count (now 4) for this signature; if it keeps recurring, escalate to CI infra owners to adjust parallelism defaults or runner sizing for Windows conditional-compilation builds specifically, since it is unrelated to incoming code changes.
historical_context: Same signature (80cfa127185fbf3e) recorded 3 prior times: runs 41586716106, 43241364429, 43336008835, first seen 2026-11-03. All previous investigations attributed the failure to Windows Release build memory exhaustion from high parallelism (C1060/LNK1102), consistent with this occurrence.
